transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this weekly sustainment review underway. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders in the holding area, all awaiting disposition. Before I sign off on the disposition plan, I need updates from each of you. Environmental, what's the status on the used oil drums and vehicle batteries? Maintenance, any changes on the batteries or cylinders? Medical logistics, where do we stand on those expired cold packs? And transportation, do we have scheduled pickups or transfers lined up for any of these categories?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the used oil, I confirmed this morning that we have exactly 18 drums accepted by the contracted recycling service, with pickup available on 26 June. The contractor confirmation is in the environmental file, but I should note it has not yet been added to the S-4 disposition worksheet. I'll make sure that gets updated. On the vehicle batteries, I don't have a confirmed disposition yet from my end.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Major, on the vehicle batteries — I counted exactly 24 cases in the holding area. The approved battery vendor requires no more than 12 cases per pallet, so this shipment must use exactly two pallets with battery-hazard labels. The count and packing instruction are in the motor-pool inspection folder, but I have not yet sent them to logistics. I'm getting that over now so it can be included in the disposition plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Major, on the expired medical cold packs — I confirmed they must be returned to Medical Supply rather than discarded locally. The return appointment is set for 25 June and is on the clinic supply calendar, but I want to flag that it has not yet been cross-referenced with the holding-area disposition plan. I'll make sure that gets reconciled before pickup.
transcript.speaker: A4

The carrier's acceptance note was received after my last transportation update, so it is not yet on the movement worksheet. I'll get it added so it's reflected in the disposition plan.
